links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance for referable diabetic retinopathy across age and sex subgroups
links.effect: Overall sensitivity 0.88, specificity 0.86, AUC 0.87; performance declined with increasing age, while sex distribution remained consistent across age groups.
links.quote: Performance declined with increasing age, whereas sex distribution remained consistent across age groups.

unlisted_practices: Real-world comparison of AI referral decisions with ophthalmologist grading, including additional non-DR referable ocular diseases (glaucoma, macular hole)

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical workflow integration and diagnostic performance of the VeriSee DR AI system compared with ophthalmologist grading across over 11,000 diabetic patients, but does not test an organizational deployment guardrail or practice.
